recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7386 unless a future Patient Care or FHIR-I decision reopens modifier-extension examples more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-7386 was a Published FHIR-core Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that the modifier-extension example not describe using Condition to assert that a patient does not have a diagnosis because that was too close to the built-in refuted meaning. The approved resolution changed the example to a Condition recording family history of the condition rather than the patient's own condition.
initial_application: Git commit fbb5823018ed5a3b9736b8a17c67c503f34a26b8 on 2015-08-31, titled '#7386 example correction', changed source/extensibility.html from the old "doesn't have a particular diagnosis (as opposed to refuted)" example to the approved family-history wording.
additional_context: The current source/extensibility.html Modifier Extensions section still contains the family-history Condition example. The page is in current build scope: source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to extensibility and the page is linked from current documentation/navigation. Jira phrase searches found the resolved family-history wording in FHIR-7386, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting FHIR-7386 record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source already conveys the approved clarification and no stale "doesn't have"/"refuted" wording remains in the relevant extensibility example.
